notes.title: Patch Note 0.2.1
notes.content:
Greetings Gifters! Our V0.2.1 update is now live with several bug fixes (sorry about those) and QOL improvements. Hope you’ve been enjoying the game so far and thank you for all your feedback!




Here is the full Patch Notes for V0.2.1:




-Fixed an issue causing widescreen monitor users to have “strange” visuals.

-Fixed an issue with Betsy orders causing the packing peanuts to stop working.

-Fixed an issue where the info button on the apps being unresponsive

-Tweaked the current economy settings to offer a more comfortable gameplay

-Added an email reminder that is to be sent to your inbox 2 days prior to rent's due date.

-Fixed an issue causing the tablet to occasionally freeze.

-Fixed an issue with item hitboxes.

-Polished the BulkBuy app

-Fixed an issue causing the texts to get mixed up for haggling customers.

-Fixed an issue causing the emails to repeat on each login.

-Adjusted the sizes of some items to appear better

-Added localized customer names for 10 languages.

-Changed some aspects of Inventory and Betsy to offer a clearer experience

-Welp now displays all ratings and not just written comments.

-Fixed an issue with Madame Bouvier causing the game to crash.

-Fixed an issue in welp causing some customers to leave 0 stars.


Thank you for playing our game and giving feedback! We hope you enjoy this update and as always Stay Gifted!

notes.title: Demo V0.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Gifted Gifters! With the release of our demo you, as the community raised some concerns and with this patch we addressed as many of them as we can. Without further ado, here are the patch notes:



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614105/c9c689930eb7b82393daa8de0381a1c4ac102eb9.jpg"]

Fixed an issue that caused the localization to mix with each other,

Fixed an issue with Bibi  (Yes the tutorial cat has a name) causing him to stay on screen after the tutorial is finished.

Added a message to tell players that their orders will arrive the next day for clarity,

Fixed an error in the Welp app causing some review texts to appear faulty,

Fixed some performance issues.

Fixed an issue in the Inventory app causing the available slots to show the wrong number,

Added some quality of life features to enhance user experience further in BulkBuy, And inventory apps as well as the wrapping station.


Thank you for playing our demo and giving feedback! We hope you enjoy this update and as always Stay Gifted!
